HALLUCINATIONS: None

The memo accurately reflects all key financial terms found in the source document:

- Date of Agreement: March 13, 2025 ✓
- Borrower and guarantor entity names are correctly listed ✓
- Credit Agreement date: December 13, 2023 ✓
- Administrative Agent: Wilmington Savings Fund Society, FSB ✓
- Consent fee: $1,000,000 in cash ✓
- Audit deadline: April 30, 2025 ✓
- Fiscal year: December 31, 2024 ✓
- Governing law: New York ✓
- Lender names (Highbridge entities, Context Partners) are accurate ✓

The memo appropriately notes "N/A" for terms not specified in the limited consent document (interest rate, maturity date, etc.) rather than fabricating information. All substantive financial and legal terms are properly supported by the source document.

ANSWER: YES
MISSING_TERMS: 
- Original Credit Agreement date (December 13, 2023) - mentioned in memo but not prominently featured in key terms
- Specific lender names and entities (Highbridge Tactical Credit Master Fund, Highbridge Tactical Credit Institutional Fund, Highbridge SCF II Special Situations SPV LP, 1992 Master Fund Co-Invest SPC Series 4 Segregated Portfolio, Context Partners Master Fund) - only generically referenced
- Wire transfer payment requirement for consent fee effectiveness
- Legal fees and expenses payment requirement as condition precedent
- Representation and warranty requirements as effectiveness conditions
- All liens and collateral interests remain in full force and effect (mentioned in risks but not in key terms table)
- Credit Agreement governs costs/expenses and indemnity provisions (Sections 10.2 and 10.3)
- Jurisdiction, venue, and jury trial waiver provisions (Sections 10.14, 10.15, 10.16)
